$skillListingBudgetFraction_comment: Abdout, 2026-09-26: 2% of the context window (default 1%). Measured with /skill-doctor: at 1% only ~25 of ~135 listed skills kept a description in kun sessions, so passive keyword routing silently lost feature/ship/spec/… — kun's operating model. Cost ≈ +6K cached tokens per turn. setup.sh merges this key into ~/.claude/settings.json, so it applies fleet-wide.

permissions.$comment: Name-level gates the PreToolUse hooks structurally CANNOT reach. scrape-guard.sh only ever sees Bash, so an MCP tool call bypasses it entirely — and open_session is the one tool that accepts a remote-browser URL, i.e. the only MCP path to the session vault. The docs also warn that argument-constraining Bash patterns are fragile, which is why the state-dependent checks (which Chrome profile backs a port RIGHT NOW) stay in the hook and only the by-name gates live here. Evaluated deny -> ask -> allow, first match wins. NOTE: setup.sh merges this file into ~/.claude/settings.json, so these become fleet-wide user-scope rules on every machine at next setup — deliberate for a safety deny, but stated rather than discovered. Both server-key spellings are shipped because rules match the key literally and the upstream docs tell users to register it under the CamelCase name.

$disabledMcpjsonServers_comment: The project .mcp.json declares the reader MCP so it is discoverable in /mcp and reviewable in git, but it is DISABLED by default: an always-on MCP puts its tool definitions in every session and invites per-page model reads on a 600+ row queue, against this lane's zero-tokens-per-lead rule. Declaring the disable here also suppresses the first-session approval prompt an undeclared .mcp.json entry would otherwise raise. To enable per-machine, set BOTH keys in .claude/settings.local.json: enabledMcpjsonServers ['scrapling'] AND disabledMcpjsonServers [] — local out-precedes project per key, so clearing the disable list is what actually lifts it.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" && { node .claude/scripts/generate-vocab.mjs --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'vocabulary drifted — run: node .claude/scripts/generate-vocab.mjs'; bash .claude/scripts/build-plugin.sh --check >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'plugins drifted — run: bash .claude/scripts/build-plugin.sh'; }; exit 0

json=$(cat); p=$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$p" ] && p="${FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -n "$p" ] && [[ "$p" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|md)$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$p" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code needs attention" with title "Captain"' 2>/dev/null; exit 0
